excerpts.content: Post-London, will Legacy txns have a different txn type than "native" 1559 ones?

excerpts.content: <@!552133098075193354> legacy txs will always be "untyped", 1559 txs will have type `2`

excerpts.author: holgerd77
excerpts.content:
<@!552133098075193354> there is an EIP though on "Wrapped Legacy Transactions" https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2972 from <@!301186049323958275> introducing types for legacy txs, not sure what the state of this is.

For EthereumJS we interally give type 0 to easier allow for type comparisons.

excerpts.author: holgerd77
excerpts.content:
I've implemented a basic `eth_sendRawTransaction` RPC method in our client for sending txs to the `baikal`  network. I have been able to send a legacy tx, however the network (respectively the two nodes I am connecting to: 3.9.20.133:30303 and 144.91.103.6:30308) is not accepting any typed txs.

Am I correct with the assumption that the final message format for a `0x02` "Transactions" message being send over the wire should be:

```shell
RLP([TRANSACTION_TYPE || RLP(TX_PAYLOAD)])
``` 

(sorry, I am not that brilliant on these kind of notations)

Or am I missing something? Any idea or hint why else this could go wrong?

excerpts.author: zsfelfoldi
excerpts.content:
<@!543900561460822016> <@!415548822983278593> Here is my modified transaction ordering scheme for 1559:
https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/22898
Just finished, not tested yet, also I want to check out some other parts of this PR, just wanted to show what I had in mind. It's +126 -44 LOC compared to the simple feeCap ordering so it's still pretty simple (and I believe safer).
